title: Batman Begins — Batman Turns His Childhood Fear Into a Weapon
concept: Bruce Wayne's greatest weakness initially appears to be his fear of bats. But Batman Begins reveals something more interesting: Bruce doesn't simply overcome his fear. He transforms it into the foundation of his identity as Batman.
core_question: What if Batman's greatest weapon was once his greatest fear?
